svg.title: Dated events of the models in L13
svg.desc: A horizontal timeline from June 2024 to October 2026 with year marks at 2025 and 2026. Dots, left to right: OpenVLA, Jun 2024; pi-0, Oct 2024; SmolVLA, Jun 2025; pi-0.5 in openpi, Sep 2025; GR00T N1.7, Apr 2026; Gemini Robotics ER 2, Jul 2026; ER 1.6 deprecated, Aug 2026. Labels alternate above and below the axis; only the horizontal position carries data.
